findings.title: Historical successful CAS result pin points to the new absent audit directory
findings.description: BASIS171 pins old result20af at r3-direct33-after-preparation-registration-cas-20261116-01/result.json. The carrier and register require this new AUDIT directory to be absent, so readonly basis cannot pass and pre-publication snapshot cannot pass. HANDOFF requires the actual completed INPUT02 CAS02 result at r3-direct33-input02-registration-cas-20261116-02/result.json. Correct the historical path in CAS/reader and generator, update carrier/source pins; do not fabricate new audit or run reader to work around.
